title: What Tariffs Really Did to Truck Prices (Model by Model)
description:
Tariffs added thirty billion dollars in costs to the car industry in one year. A Chevrolet Silverado LT now costs twelve point six percent more than it did two years ago. But a Toyota Tacoma costs less than one percent more. And the biggest price jump on your next truck might not be the truck at all. Here is what tariffs really did to truck prices, model by model.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:57 The industry numbers
3:38 1. Chevrolet Silverado
4:49 2. GMC Sierra
5:54 3. Ford F-150
7:02 4. Ram 1500
8:04 5. Toyota Tacoma
9:10 6. The destination fee
10:47 The verdict
20:22 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
So we collected the published data. For the industry-wide picture, we used the Cox Automotive release reported by CBT News in March of twenty twenty-six. For the truck-by-truck prices, we used the analysis by TFL Car, which compared the landed cost of the most popular trims in twenty twenty-four with twenty twenty-six. Landed cost means the sticker price plus the destination fee. Every source is listed in the description.
